columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Ordered worker queues separate scheduled intent from execution authority
columns.title_zh: 顺序工作队列将已排程意图与执行权分离
columns.source_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 维护者版本变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260811-G-007. It is the strongest bounded Digital Employee runtime object in today's pool: newly queued prompts and commands wait behind the current task, multiple sessions are explicit, and MCP startup failure is bounded instead of stalling indefinitely. Skill 02 score: 48/50. The mechanism directly supports a worker inbox, ordered execution authority, visible runtime state and recovery behavior.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260811-G-007。它是今日信号池中最强的有界数字员工运行对象：新排入的 Prompt 与命令等待当前任务结束后按序执行，多会话被显式管理，MCP 启动失败也被限制为快速失败而非无限挂起。Skill 02 评分 48/50，直接支持 Worker Inbox、顺序执行权、可见运行状态与恢复治理。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the queue ordering model, which work items are queueable, session concurrency boundaries, cancellation/failure behavior, MCP startup timeout semantics, and how effective sandbox policy is surfaced. Do not enter Research Analysis.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 Queue Ordering 模型、可排队工作项范围、Session 并发边界、取消/失败行为、MCP 启动 Timeout 语义以及 Effective Sandbox Policy 的呈现方式，不得提前进入 Research Analysis。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Reservation availability turns assistant recommendations into governed action handoff
columns.title_zh: 预约可用性将助手推荐推进为受边界治理的行动衔接
columns.source_zh: OpenAI ChatGPT 官方发布说明
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260811-P-001. It provides a bounded architecture question about where an assistant stops being a recommender and starts participating in an externally grounded action flow: availability is retrieved from booking services, a user selects a concrete time, and the product explicitly preserves plan-level availability boundaries. Skill 02 score: 42/50. This is sufficiently specific to study connector-mediated action handoff, authority boundaries and product-surface governance without broadening into generic consumer AI.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260811-P-001。它形成一个明确的架构问题：助手何时从“推荐”进入由外部真实状态支撑的行动流程——系统从预订服务获取可用性，用户选择具体时间，同时产品又显式保留套餐级可用边界。Skill 02 评分 42/50，可聚焦研究 Connector-mediated Action Handoff、权限边界与产品入口治理，而无需扩展成泛化的消费级 AI 讨论。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the exact reservation flow, participating providers, user handoff boundary, supported/unsupported product surfaces, and what evidence remains inside ChatGPT versus the external booking service. Do not infer booking completion beyond the documented handoff.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查预约流程、参与 Provider、用户衔接边界、支持/不支持的产品入口，以及哪些证据留在 ChatGPT、哪些转交外部预订服务；不得把文档中的 Handoff 推断为已由 ChatGPT 完成最终预订。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Durable event identity and terminal-state evidence reduce ambiguous completion
columns.title_zh: 持久事件身份与终态证据降低模糊完成状态
columns.source_zh: Google ADK Python 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260811-G-002. It is the strongest engineering evidence in today's pool for explicit runtime evidence: event IDs are assigned before enqueue, an opt-in committed-stream offset mode prevents duplicates, offset conflicts are recorded, and sanitized finish/error plus workflow-node terminal events are emitted. Skill 02 score: 46/50. The mechanism is directly testable and maps to evidence-ledger, duplicate-control and terminal-state verification design.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260811-G-002。它是今日信号池中关于显式运行证据最强的工程对象：Event ID 在入队前分配，可选 Committed-stream Offset 模式用于防重复，Offset Conflict 被记录，同时输出经过清理的 Finish/Error 与 Workflow Node 终态事件。Skill 02 评分 46/50，可直接验证并映射到 Evidence Ledger、重复控制与终态核验设计。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify event-ID assignment timing, committed-stream offset semantics, conflict/drop behavior, finish/error event schema, workflow-node terminal events, opt-in/default boundaries and failure modes. Do not generalize to exactly-once semantics beyond the implemented path.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 Event ID 分配时机、Committed-stream Offset 语义、Conflict/Drop 行为、Finish/Error Event Schema、Workflow Node 终态事件、Opt-in/默认边界及失败模式；不得把该实现路径扩大解释为全系统 Exactly-once。
